adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then unconditionally passes the returned `resp` into `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, this.log)`. But `refreshOAuthTokens`’s sync-mode branch (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and its inline comment says the sync endpoint response “should only contain the access token and expiry date” (i.e., not Lark’s `RefreshTokenResp` shape). Since the subsequent Lark-specific logic expects a Lark refresh-token response structure, in sync mode the parsed data is likely missing nested fields (e.g., `data.data...`) and will break. Unlike other integrations in this diff, Lark does not use `parseRefreshTokenResponse` to tolerate a minimal token shape.
